Removed P2P, now have servers in Hong Kong. The latency in Mmultiplayer is horrible.

Edit: 
There is a workaround that works for me. 
Steam -> Settings -> In Game -> Steam Networking
Change this to "always".

Remember to change it back if it causes Problems with other games.

I'm not sure if i understand the devs reply correctly. It only switches to their server if my P2P connection is bad? This was most certainly not the case.
Changing review back to recommend, because the game is amazing. However, this issue should be looked into.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you for your review.
When the P2P connection quality between players in the team is poor, it will attempt to automatically connect to the nearest game server to improve the online experience.You can optimize the network and regroup to re-enable P2P for online play.
